discordPostHtml:
Adds new skills to, increases the level of, and adjusts salary values for, administrators. Skills are designed to be powerful and effective in ways structures/ai cores arent but expensive to run - making an Alpha Core an ideal stopgap for when you don't want to use an expensive administrator, or don't have one with the skillset you need.

Made because I was annoyed that there was LITERALLY NO REASON to use administrators. Now there is!

Some examples:

  1. Quality Control - Adds smods and increases ship quality of fleets launched by the colony.
  2. Damage control - Increases ground defense and makes structures have a maximum disrupted duration.
  3. Safety Protocols - Decrease hazard rating, increase stability.

And more...

Can be added to a existing save. Cannot be removed.

No AI was used in the creation of this mod.
